Container.Name: FormCraft
Container.Overview:
FormCraft is a self-hosted form builder: a drag-and-drop builder with 10 field types and templates, quizzes with scoring, a submissions table with filters, charts and CSV export, users and roles, email and Telegram alerts, multilingual forms (English, Arabic, Tamil) with right-to-left support, light and dark themes, and full system backups.
DATABASE: this template uses the built-in SQLite database, stored in the Data folder below. Nothing else to install. To use PostgreSQL instead, change Repository to ghcr.io/shatheitguy/formcraft:postgres and set Database URL to postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:5432/DBNAME?schema=public (create the empty database first; the tables build themselves on first start).
First run: open the WebUI and create your admin account. There is no default password.
Container.Description: Self-hosted form builder: drag-and-drop forms, templates, quizzes, submissions with charts and CSV export, roles, email/Telegram alerts, multilingual forms and dark mode.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port you open FormCraft on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, uploaded logos and cover images, and restore snapshots. Keep this folder in your backups.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Leave as is for SQLite. For PostgreSQL use the :postgres image and postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/formcraft?schema=public

Config.Name: Demo data
Config.Description: Load 4 demo forms with sample responses into an empty database.

Config.Name: Per-form port range
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. 4001-4010: every form gets its own port that serves only that form. Also add each port to the container (or use Host networking).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the Data folder (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the Data folder (100 = users on Unraid).
